column1: # Holdout predictions locked before the two workbooks' fresh direct Excel exports (2026-11-24T06:47Z).
# Workbooks: tests/test-documents-excel/synthetic-print-textpad-holdout-georgia.xlsx (Georgia 12, print scale 75%, three alignment
# sheets H_G_left/center/right) and tests/test-documents-excel/synthetic-print-textpad-holdout-tahoma.xlsx (Tahoma 10, 100%).
# Locked workbook hashes: georgia 680f01021fee2cbda316521fb548ffc275345aa4049740c9a86544c870c692b3,
# tahoma fb0acf8d2a279d2d4131a5448c9a882e6a3f0fa93bda5eca68bf5ea2e19e9488 (written before either export).
# Metric: Poppler pdftotext -bbox word box of the displayed text, against the adjacent solid-fill cell edge
# (yellow B = text, blue C = numeric control) from pdftocairo SVG, never raster ink.
# adv(P) = the held-out face's printed advance of pad character P; padX = Excel's 4+ceil(d/4)-dot text inset.
# All numeric relations are to the same PDF's F00 row in the same alignment, so they are independent of
# page geometry and of any absolute page offset.
test   sheets        face/scale          relation                                                              accept

REL_F04_L  H_*_left    all              xMin(F04 _(@) - xMin(F00) = adv(()                                     1.0 <= delta <= 7.0
